name: 2.9.20 - Diagnostics upload to GitHub
notes: Save diagnostics and Diagnostics ZIP to Desktop (and the wholesale helper's Save diagnostics) also upload the saved ZIP to Tommy's private GitHub repository tommyvenzin/tempe-diagnostics, so Claude can read it there. The ZIP is still saved and shown as before; the upload runs in the background and says where it went, or why not. Set it up once for each Windows login with the new GitHub upload button: Open GitHub (the token page comes filled in), pick Only select repositories > tempe-diagnostics, Generate token, paste it and click Save. The same token can be pasted on every PC, and Ebay-auto 1.1.11 uses it too under the same login. Remove for this Windows login takes it off; not set up, ZIPs are only saved, as before. Only diagnostics ZIPs are sent, only to that private repository, and GitHub tokens are masked out of the diagnostics. Nothing is sold or saved in COSTAR. Not yet tried on the RDP PC. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
